canonical_objects: the partial causal effect of attention block 11 on narrative past-versus-present prediction
attention-11 head 3 versus the other eight heads on the frozen narrative-tense counterfactuals
whether the Task-14 agreement head is also active for narrative tense
matched_prior_claims: The frozen narrative-tense screen found attention block 11 moves the donor answer margin in both constructions, with A1 recovery 0.3516 and A2 recovery 0.2352, but it did not pass the 0.40 site-selection bar and therefore never expanded to heads.
The frozen Task-14 agreement screen found attention-11 head 3 carries most of attention block 11's agreement interchange effect.

The narrative-tense authority explicitly warns that agreement and tense share a copular answer position but encode different variables; a shared output token is therefore a live confound, not evidence of a shared semantic state.
The short-cue narrative-tense follow-up stopped at native capability and contains no attention-head evidence.
novelty_delta: First fixed decomposition of the known partial attention-11 narrative-tense effect into head 3, the other eight heads, and their downstream interaction. It does not claim that a native head is the final basis. It is a cheap gate: only if head 3 is causally active on both tense constructions is a below-head source/value comparison with agreement licensed.

registered_predictions.shared_copular_service: Head 3 alone contributes at least half of the frozen full-attention-11 effect in every A1/A2 direction cell, moves at least 75 percent of rows donorward, and does not create larger normalized movement on P or C than the frozen whole attention block.
registered_predictions.task_split: The other eight heads or their interaction account for most of the frozen attention-11 effect, or head 3 fails the cellwise direction/effect requirements.
registered_predictions.interpretation_limit: Even a shared-copular-service result does not identify a shared tense/agreement state because both tasks can predict the token ' is'. It only licenses exact source-term and output-effect tests that can separate semantic reuse from a generic copula write.

decision_changed: A positive head-3 result advances to exact source-score/cached-value decomposition and cross-task downstream-response controls. A negative result kills the proposed agreement-by-tense head-3 grouping route and preserves the attention-11 effect as a different-head or interactive tense mechanism.
